summary: Lists internal Module Replacer substitutions (ANSIBLE_VERSION, INCLUDE_ANSIBLE_MODULE_COMPLEX_ARGS, SELINUX_SPECIAL_FILESYSTEMS, INCLUDE_ANSIBLE_MODULE_JSON_ARGS, syslog.LOG_USER) and the AnsibleModule attributes to use instead in Ansiballz modules.
questions: How do I get the Ansible version inside a Python module?
How do I access module parameters in a new-style module?
How do I get the configured syslog facility in a module?

answer_card.title: Internal replacements and their Ansiballz equivalents
answer_card.answer_md:
In Ansiballz modules, use `AnsibleModule` attributes instead of the old placeholders:
- `<<ANSIBLE_VERSION>>` → `module.ansible_version`
- `<<INCLUDE_ANSIBLE_MODULE_COMPLEX_ARGS>>` → `module.params`
- `<<SELINUX_SPECIAL_FILESYSTEMS>>` → `module._selinux_special_fs` (now a list)
- `<<INCLUDE_ANSIBLE_MODULE_JSON_ARGS>>` isn't substituted in new-style Python
- `syslog.LOG_USER` → `module._syslog_facility` (now the facility *name*)
